The [[Aegis of the Condemned]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from [[Vraxx the Condemned]], a [[boss]] who spawns on the second level of [[Cathedral of Flames]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:Received [[Physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

*[[Mallyx's Defense]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Tactics)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Tactics Shield]], [[Droknar's Tactics Shield]], [[Sunreach's Shield]], and [[Shield of the Hierophant]] have stats identical to this item.
